summary: EVERTEC filed an 8-K announcing its wholly-owned subsidiary Evertec Brasil Informática S.A. completed the purchase of 100% of Dimensa S.A., a Brazil-based B2B tech provider for financial institutions. The final aggregate purchase price was approximately R$981 million (~USD$197 million), subject to customary closing adjustments. The acquisition was funded from existing liquidity. No board recommendation, advisors, or premiums were disclosed. The filing confirms a closed deal; no regulatory clock remains. Watch for integration progress in EVERTEC's LatAm segment.
